A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same PPCL study with 21 readable pages, including supplementary sections 6–10. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical content except for the first-page arXiv version/date stamp and its associated link.

before.justification: v1 reports original PPCL compression experiments and ablations in Tables 1–2, detailed benchmark results in Tables 3–6, and generation and image-editing examples.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original experiments, ablations, benchmark results, and qualitative examples in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithms 1–2 retain identical linear probing, redundant-interval detection, non-sequential distillation, and depth-wise and width-wise pruning procedures.

E1.justification: Both retain LAION-2B-en training data and evaluation on DPG, GenEval, OneIG, T2I-CompBench, and LongText-Bench, including the same English/Chinese coverage and appendix image-editing examples.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains identical comparator membership within each model-specific comparison, including FLUX.1 Lite, Chroma1-HD, Dense2MoE, TinyFusion, and HierarchicalPrune where applicable.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and supplementary section 6 retain the same sample counts, calibration data, training stages and budgets, model configurations, pruning ratios, and evaluation metrics.

E4.justification: The layer-removal analyses, Table 2 component ablations, qualitative comparisons, and Figure 13 failure cases are identical. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both specify inference seed 42 and the same averaging procedure for calibration CKA. Neither introduces repeated-run uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–6 and all plotted and qualitative results are unchanged. For example, Table 1 reports the same 3.29% average performance drop for the fine-tuned 10B Qwen-Image variant.

T1.justification: Equations 1–18 and their accompanying mathematical definitions and reasoning are identical; no assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain identical claims about contiguous redundancy, pluggable pruning without configuration-specific retraining, and compression with preserved generation quality.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations are unchanged, including the heuristic basis of CKA interval detection, poor INT4 quantization performance, and difficulties rendering excessively long or small text in sections 5 and 10.

D1.justification: Hardware, optimizer settings, training details, calibration instructions, layer selections, and code/checkpoint access information are identical. The changed arXiv version link does not alter resource access information.

R1.justification: Section 2, research positioning, and all 57 references are unchanged.

P1.justification: Only the marginal arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 20 November 2025 to v2 dated 24 February 2026, with its corresponding version link updated. Manuscript wording and section structure are identical.

P2.justification: All figures, tables, captions, and manuscript layouts are identical, including the appendix image grids and failure cases. The stamp text update introduces no figure, table, or layout revision.

improvement.justification: The complete scientific content and presentation, including all appendix evidence and limitations, are unchanged. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp and its link leaves the paper's overall quality unchanged.
